correctness.rationale: A_lambda has local radical J=(x,y,z), J²=kz and J³=0. Every field-linear anti-involution preserves J and has image coefficients L in GL2(k) and socle row h. Square-zero images and reversed xy relations force monomial L unless lambda=1, and for nonresonant lambda exclude diagonal L; sigma²=I fixes antidiagonal scaling/corrections. For lambda=-1 in odd characteristic, four diagonal fibers appear alongside the antidiagonal family. For lambda=1 in odd characteristic L²=I, hL=(det L)h, stratified by eigenvalues ±1 to give components dimensions 3,2,0. In characteristic two L=I+N, N²=0, hN=0; incidence variety irreducible dim3, and closure of nonzero N includes the N=0 plane. Exact orbit/field counts give q(q-1), 2q²+q+1, q³+2q²+1, q³+q²−q and explicit fixed-space histograms. Independent brute-force original multiplication/reversed-relations checks over GF2,GF3,GF5 verified all cases including 10,22,46,56,176 maps; this finite confirmation does not establish arbitrary k.
